metadata.datasetName: S&P 500 Top 20 Weekly Closing Prices — Sample
metadata.weekNumberConvention: 1 is the oldest observation; 52 is the newest observation
metadata.rankingBasis: Current S&P 500 companies ranked by index weight/market capitalisation
